chunks: 2987 - Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"When you pass through Wādī Muḥassir, and it is a great valley between Jamʿ and Minā, and it is closer to Minā, then hasten in it until you pass beyond it. For indeed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم quickened his she-camel there and said:
"O Allah, keep my covenant secure, accept my repentance, answer my supplication, and succeed me with goodness among those whom I left behind after me."

key_terms.وَادِي مُحَسِّرٍ: Wādī Muḥassir, the valley between Jamʿ and Minā mentioned in the hajj rite

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do when passing through Wādī Muḥassir, and what du'a is recited there?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the pilgrim to hasten while passing through Wādī Muḥassir between Jamʿ and Minā during hajj. It also preserves a supplication of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in that place, combining ritual practice with du'a and repentance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2987 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"When you pass through the Valley of Muhassir—a significant valley between Jam‘ (Muzdalifah) and Mina, closer to Mina—hasten through it until you have crossed it.
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) quickened his camel's pace in this valley and said:
'O Allah (swt), secure my covenant, accept my repentance, answer my supplication, and bless those I have left behind with goodness after me.'"
